ns2:section.sectionText: In this course students learn process models of healthcare delivery, and concepts of process analysis and process optimization for performance under resource constraints. This course will cover the following topics: Understanding the US Healthcare Delivery System. Advantages and vulnerabilities of managed care. Measuring Healthcare Quality. Measures of healthcare performance and quality such as readmissions. Understanding Patient Satisfaction and Patient Experience. Measuring patient satisfaction, and factors associated with patient experience and satisfaction. Managing Process Flows. Understand pathways of patient flow through the healthcare system. Managing Preventative Care. Preventative care scheduling and risk-based optimization. Designing processes for access and affordability. Delivering healthcare to a diverse set of populations.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Technology Management-UIUC, MS:Management -UIUC, or MS:Business Analytics - UIUC.
